Emre Yalcin  
NexaGame Studios | Istanbul, Turkey | +90 532 123 4567 | emre.yalcin@nexagame.com  

A QA engineer with 12 years of experience in gaming, specializing in test automation, performance validation, and cross-team collaboration. Focused on delivering reliable, scalable testing frameworks that align with agile development cycles. Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical test strategies, reducing bug escapes by 35% in recent roles.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **Test Automation**: Developed and maintained end-to-end test suites for AAA titles, integrating Selenium and Playwright to cover web and desktop platforms.  
- **Performance Testing**: Architected JMeter-based solutions to simulate 10,000 concurrent users, identifying latency bottlenecks in multiplayer game servers.  
- **API Testing**: Owned the testing lifecycle for game backend services, reducing critical API errors by 40% through automated regression suites.  
- **BDD/TDD**: Led the adoption of Cucumber and JUnit, aligning test cases with user stories and improving defect detection during sprints.  
- **Integration Testing**: Designed systems to validate third-party SDKs, ensuring compatibility with Unity and Unreal Engine pipelines.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Integrated Jenkins and GitLab CI into release workflows, enabling nightly test execution for 15+ game modules.  
- **Python**: Automated data parsing for test environments, streamlining setup for 80% of regression scenarios.  
- **Test Strategy Design**: Mentored junior engineers on test pyramid principles, reducing manual testing hours by 25% across teams.  
- **Selenium/Playwright**: Built a reusable framework for cross-browser testing, cutting regression time by 30% in browser-specific scenarios.  
- **k6/JMeter**: Optimized load testing scripts to reflect real-world player behavior, improving server stability during peak hours.
